scoring: Score each item 1 to 5 with items 1, 2 and 8 reverse keyed as shown in the item notes, sum to a raw score of 8 to 40 (all items must be answered to use the conversion table), then convert to a T score (mean 50, SD 10 in the US general population) with the HealthMeasures table for Adult Sleep Disturbance 8a v1.0 (raw=T): 8=30.5, 9=35.3, 10=38.1, 11=40.4, 12=42.2, 13=43.9, 14=45.3, 15=46.7, 16=47.9, 17=49.1, 18=50.2, 19=51.3, 20=52.4, 21=53.4, 22=54.3, 23=55.3, 24=56.2, 25=57.2, 26=58.1, 27=59.1, 28=60.0, 29=61.0, 30=62.0, 31=63.0, 32=64.0, 33=65.1, 34=66.2, 35=67.4, 36=68.7, 37=70.2, 38=72.0, 39=74.1, 40=77.5. Higher T scores indicate more sleep disturbance. HealthMeasures severity bands used with the DSM-5 Level 2 adaptation: less than 55 none to slight, 55.0 to 59.9 mild, 60.0 to 69.9 moderate, 70 and over severe. The scoring manual notes the 8a table was revised 22 May 2014 and recommends the HealthMeasures Scoring Service for response pattern scoring.
citation: Buysse, D. J., Yu, L., Moul, D. E., Germain, A., Stover, A., Dodds, N. E., Johnston, K. L., Shablesky-Cade, M. A., & Pilkonis, P. A. (2010). Development and validation of patient-reported outcome measures for sleep disturbance and sleep-related impairments. Sleep, 33(6), 781–792. https://doi.org/10.1093/sleep/33.6.781
transcriptionNote: healthmeasures.net search pages are behind a form and the NIH HEAL CRF PDF redirected to a landing page, so no official 8a PDF could be read. Items 1 to 6 (text, item IDs Sleep109, Sleep116, Sleep20, Sleep44, Sleep108 and Sleep72 by LOINC code, response lists and keying) were transcribed from the LOINC panel for Sleep Disturbance 6a v1.0 (76703-8), whose 6 items are the first 6 of the 8a form, and from the 4a panel (75258-4). Items 7 and 8 and the 8 item order were taken from the psytests.org rendering of SF-8a (https://psytests.org/diag/promS8en-bl.html), which is not an official form; item 8's reverse keying is confirmed by LOINC 61985-8 in the 8b panel, item 7's keying is inferred from its negative wording. The DSM-5 Level 2 Sleep Disturbance Adult PDF on psychiatry.org and the NIDDK MAPP form both reproduce the 8b item set (restless, satisfied, refreshing, difficulty falling asleep, trouble staying asleep, trouble sleeping, got enough sleep, sleep quality), not 8a, so they were not used for items. Instructions recorded as the LOINC item stem "In the past 7 days"; the full PROMIS instruction ("Please respond to each item by marking one box per row") appears on the 8b MAPP form and is presumably identical. T score table from the PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Scoring Manual copy at curesicklecell.rti.org. Response options field shows the standard Not at all to Very much list; per item lists differ and are given in each item note.
